The '''seizure of Moorja''' occurred in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] when the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] wrested control of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Moorja/Legends|Moorja]] from the control of [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Sander Delvardus]].

During the [[Space warfare/Legends|battle]], a fleet of [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigates]], supported by [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing bombers]], destroyed the ''[[Thalassa]]'', a [[Praetor Mark II-class battlecruiser|''Praetor Mark II''-class battlecruiser]].<ref name="TEGTW" />

Following their victory, the Republic established a [[New Republic Moorjan base|permanent base]] on the planet, from which it launched strikes against Imperial targets in the following [[Standard year/Legends|years]].<ref name="TEA" />
